title: DevOps Engineer
overview: A DevOps Engineer bridges the gap between development and operations by automating software delivery pipelines, provisioning infrastructure as code, managing container orchestration with Kubernetes, and maintaining cloud platform reliability. They work with CI/CD tools, monitoring systems, and cloud providers to ensure rapid, reliable software deployment.
required_technical_skills: CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
required_soft_skills: Cross-team collaboration with developers and security
career_roadmap: 1. Master Linux system administration and shell scripting.
2. Learn Docker: build images, compose services, manage multi-container apps.
3. Study Kubernetes: deployments, services, ConfigMaps, Helm charts.
4. Build CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
5. Learn a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and deploy applications.
6. Practice infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
7. Build monitoring and alerting dashboards with Prometheus and Grafana.
8. Target Junior DevOps or SRE roles.
